title: 第2章 潘金莲和炊饼
slug: 满级小李飞刀我在水浒当判官
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

没错，李逸是个来自现代的穿越者。

但与别人不同，他连着穿了两次。

第一次他穿到了古龙系列小说的主角李寻欢身上，那时的李寻欢刚刚考上探花，乃是江湖上一颗冉冉升起的新星。

作为一个现代人，李逸可没有李寻欢的脑中迂腐道德，得了那一身惊艳本领，他简直如鱼得水。

迎娶林诗音，虐杀龙啸云，之后更是在官场一路向上，直接当上了锦衣卫都指挥使。

无论什么金钱帮，也不论什么上官金虹和天机老人，只要挡在他面前之人，他尽数无情碾碎。

结果就是原著里37岁才从关外归来的李寻欢，35岁的时候直接一统江湖。

然后一天晚上，他在庭中搂着林诗音和孙小红喝酒的时候。

直接就被雷给霹死了。

可能是行事太过嚣张，老天爷都看不过眼了吧。

本来李逸以为死了的话便能回到原本世界，岂料他一睁眼，竟出现在了大宋政和三年殿试的现场。

来到了正在答题的年轻举子李逸身上。

这家伙刚刚二十三岁，来自大名府，是个容貌俊秀的读书种子，解试和省试之时都名列前茅。

李逸花了十几秒便接受了自己二次穿越的事实。

吸取了上一次经验的他决定小心行事，尽量不去直接干涉历史本身的发展。

于是他低调答题。

以至于中了探花。

没办法，李寻欢的才情那是藏也藏不住啊。

不过再低调，人还是有底线的，既然来了，李逸便绝不可能让靖康之耻再度发生，如果因为这种原因老天爷再发雷霹死他，那他也认了。

琼林赐宴上，他一篇《北疆十策》让官家都赞叹连连，老谋深算的蔡京见状直接出手，当场招李逸做了孙女婿。

蔡京这奸相恶名累累，李逸本不愿与他扯上关系，但他一个年轻学子，彼时可没有拒绝的能力。

况且他孙女蔡文茵长的那是真美，几乎不输神仙姐姐，万一被某个糙汉染指，也是暴殄天物。

没办法，先苦一苦自己吧。

依附蔡京，成为蔡京，最终打倒蔡京，拯救国家，李逸决定这么走下去。

于是在一个月之内，他中举，大婚，风头一时无两，连状元和榜眼都被他这探花给比了下去。

然而时间一久，李逸却越来越觉得不对劲。

因为的他发现京师的居然有个殿帅府，里面太尉名叫高俅。

这与历史不符，真实的历史当中，大宋根本就没有所谓的殿帅府这个机构，作为一个初级文史爱好者，这点常识李逸还是有的。

殿帅府太尉高俅只存在于一处地方。

那就是小说《水浒传》！

好嘛，搞半天这不是正史，而是水浒时间线。

后来的多方证据也佐证了这一点，李逸发现这高俅不仅有个声名狼藉的养子，更在不久前把一个叫林冲的禁军教头刺配去了沧州。

既然是水浒，那还犹豫个啥？

干死宋江，收服武松啊！

搞明白了这一点之后，李逸大彻大悟，他这一身继承自李寻欢的本领，也算有了用武之地。

于是在蔡京和他商量官场起点的时候，他毫不犹豫的选择了阳谷县，正常的时间线里，武松会在政和四年十月成为这里的都头。

然后就是西门庆和潘金莲事发，武大郎惨死，武松斗杀西门庆。

Page (1/3)

Yes, Li Yi is a time traveler from modern times.

But unlike others, he wore it twice in a row.

For the first time, he crossed over to Li Xunhuan, the protagonist of the Gu Long series of novels. At that time, Li Xunhuan had just passed the examination and was a rising star in the world.

As a modern person, Li Yi does not have the pedantic morals in Li Xunhuan's mind. With his amazing abilities, he is like a duck in water.

Marrying Lin Shiyin, brutally killing Long Xiaoyun, and then working his way up in the officialdom, directly becoming the commander of the Imperial Guard.

No matter who the money gang is, no matter who Shangguan Jinhong or Old Man Tianji is, he will ruthlessly crush anyone who stands in his way.

The result is that Li Xunhuan, who returned from outside the customs at the age of 37 in the original work, directly dominated the world at the age of 35.

Then one night, he was drinking with Lin Shiyin and Sun Xiaohong in his arms in the court.

He was immediately struck to death by thunder.

Maybe he was acting too arrogantly, and even God couldn't stand it.

Li Yi originally thought that if he died, he would be able to return to his original world. Unexpectedly, when he opened his eyes, he appeared at the scene of the Song Dynasty Zhenghe's third-year imperial examination.

It came to the young scholar Li Yi who was answering questions.

This guy was just twenty-three years old and came from Daming Prefecture. He was a good-looking scholar who ranked among the best in both the interpretation and provincial examinations.

It took Li Yi more than ten seconds to accept the fact that he had traveled through time for the second time.

Having learned from the previous experience, he decided to proceed with caution and try not to directly interfere with the development of history itself.

So he answered the questions in a low-key manner.

So much so that he won the third prize.

There is no way, Li Xunhuan's talent cannot be hidden.

However, no matter how low-key one is, one still has a bottom line. Now that he is here, Li Yi will never let the disgrace of Jingkang happen again. If God strikes him to death again for this reason, then he will admit it.

At the banquet given by Qiong Lin, his article "Ten Strategies for Northern Xinjiang" made the officials praise him repeatedly. Upon seeing this, Cai Jing, a wily man, took action and recruited Li Yi as his grandson-in-law on the spot.

Cai Jing was notorious for being a traitor, and Li Yi did not want to have anything to do with him, but as a young student, he did not have the ability to refuse at that time.

Besides, his granddaughter Cai Wenyin is really beautiful, almost as beautiful as the fairy sister. If some rough guy gets her hands on her, it will be a waste of money.

There is no other way, just suffer yourself first.

Li Yi decided to stick to Cai Jing, become Cai Jing, and finally defeat Cai Jing and save the country.

So within a month, he won the imperial examination, got married, and became so popular that even the top pick and the second pick were outshone by him.

However, as time passed, Li Yi felt more and more something was wrong.

Because of this, he discovered that there was actually a Palace Commander's Mansion in the capital, and the Taiwei named Gao Qiu was there.

This is inconsistent with history. In real history, there was no so-called Dianshuai Mansion in the Song Dynasty. As a junior lover of literature and history, Li Yi still had this common sense.

Gao Qiu, the commander-in-chief of the palace, only existed in one place.

That is the novel "Water Margin"!

Well, it took me a long time to do this. This is not official history, but the Water Margin timeline.

Later, various evidences also supported this point. Li Yi discovered that Gao Qiu not only had a notorious adopted son, but he had also assassinated a Forbidden Army instructor named Lin Chong to Cangzhou not long ago.

Since it’s Water Margin, why are you hesitating?

Kill Song Jiang and conquer Wu Song!

After understanding this, Li Yi realized that the skills he inherited from Li Xunhuan could be put to use.

So when Cai Jing discussed with him the starting point of officialdom, he chose Yanggu County without hesitation. In the normal timeline, Wu Song would become the capital here in October of the fourth year of Zhenghe.

Then came the incident between Ximen Qing and Pan Jinlian, Wu Dalang died tragically, and Wu Song fought to kill Ximen Qing.
